findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION Observed caulking to be in a state of disrepair at the front hand sink by the drive thru window. Discussed with PIC, PIC told Inspector that the caulking will get replaced. Ensure the caulking is repair providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
